description_en: Queries the number status of an AI batch task
description_zh: AI批量任务查询号码状态
name: Details

parameters.help_en: The start time of the import. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the import. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 结束导入时间  yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number status to query. Valid values:
1: Failed to call.
2: Call in progress.
3: Call completed
parameters.help_zh:
需要精确查询的号码状态：
1.未能外呼；
2.进行中外呼；
3.已完成外呼；
parameters.name: number_status

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

CallDesc.description_en:
The call status description, such as "Answered" or "Rejected".
When the number status is 1, the corresponding descriptions are:
-516 "Outbound number concurrency limit"
-515 "Number frequency limited"
-514 "No line configured"
-513 "Concurrency limit"
-512 "Outside calling hours"
-511 "Blocked area code"
-310 "Waiting for distribution"
-210 "Call canceled (payment query failed)"
-110 "Call canceled (already paid)"
-20 "Agent offline"
-19 "Agent did not answer"
-18 "Failed to call agent"
-17 "Call canceled"
-16 "Timeout without calling"
-15 "Failed to obtain voice gateway information"
-14 "Failed to convert MD5 to phone number"
-13 "Failed to pre-cache audio file"
When the number status is 2, the corresponding descriptions are:
-12 "Pre-caching audio file"
-11 "Waiting to pre-cache audio file"
-10 "Not started"
-9 "Waiting to call"
-8 "Calling"
-7 "AI call in progress"
-6 "Assigning agent"
-5 "Manual call in progress"
-4 "Monitoring ringing"
-3 "Monitoring failed"
-2 "Monitoring"
When the number status is 3, the corresponding descriptions are:
1 "Answered"
2 "Powered off"
3 "Invalid number"
4 "Number changed"
5 "Out of service"
6 "Busy"
7 "Rejected"
8 "Unreachable"
9 "Missed"
10 "Overdue payment"
11 "Line failure"
12 "Call failed"
30 "Intercepted" 
40 "Daily call limit reached"

CallType.description_en:
The outbound call type. Valid values:
2001: Batch - Predictive outbound call.
2002: Batch - AI outbound call - No transfer to agent.
2003: Batch - AI outbound call - Transfer to agent on answer.
2004: Batch - AI outbound call - Intelligent transfer to agent.
2005: Batch - Voice notification
CallType.description_zh:
外呼类型 可选项：
2001:批量-预测外呼，2002:批量-AI外呼-不转人工，2003:批量-AI外呼-接通转人工，2004: 批量-AI外呼-智能转人工,2005:批量-语音通知

ImportTime.description_en: The import time. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

InterceptReason.description_en: The intercept reason. When the status is intercepted, valid values: blacklist interception, graylist interception, or abnormal number interception
